title: Secretive OpenAI "Lobster" Model Develops a Detailed MarioKart Prototype
author: epic-cookie64
selftext: Tested it on web dev arena. While it's not fully functional, the general idea is there, especially for this being only one prompt.

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body: where do I get more information about this lobster model?

replies.author: epic-cookie64
replies.body: You can test it in web dev arena (with luck) but no one really knows what it is.

comments.author: PikachuDash
comments.body: Have you tried the same prompt with other models like Claude and Gemini? I'm curious how this model compares to them in this task.

replies.author: DisasterNarrow4949
replies.body: In this site you don't choose which model to use. Two models are randomly selected, their name don't show, and you ask something in the prompt text box. Then after the two generate the code, you vote which is better. Only after that, the name of the models are shown.

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body:
Just tried this Web Dev Arena site, and it is absolutely awesome.

And... Holy shiiiiet... what is this Nectarine model!!!!??? Just asked for an absurdely hard task, with lots specifications, very detailed, that require some rather complex algorithms... and it nailed every single thing perfectly. Wtf.

replies.author: epic-cookie64
replies.body: Yeah. Nectarine is speculated to be GPT-5 mini. Lobster is even better.

replies.author: DisasterNarrow4949
replies.body: Dude. I was just reading some redditors trashing on OpenAI/GPT by speculating that gpt 5 will just be some small incremental change. If Nectarine is really GPT 5, this is going to be a revolution on software development. Absolutely insane what it generated for me in the WebDev Arena.
